description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the harmfulness with refusals ratio and model scale, measured by the number of parameters, for four different models across two benchmarks. The x-axis, labeled "128", "256", "512", and "1024", represents the model scale in thousands of parameters, with a logarithmic progression. The y-axis, labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio", ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, indicating the proportion of harmful queries that the model refuses. Four distinct models are plotted: Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange line with square markers), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green line with triangle markers), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red line with diamond markers). The Qwen2-VL-7B model on FigStep starts at a ratio of approximately 0.15 at 128k parameters and increases to about 0.42 at 1024k parameters, showing a steady upward trend. The LlaVA-1.5-7B model on MMSafetyBench begins at a ratio of approximately 0.06 at 128k parameters and rises to about 0.38 at 1024k parameters. The Qwen2-VL-7B model on MMSafetyBench starts at a ratio of approximately 0.24 at 128k parameters and increases to about 0.52 at 1024k parameters, exhibiting the highest ratio and steepest increase among the four. All three models show an increasing trend in the harmfulness with refusal ratio as the model scale increases.
